import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        final long MOD = 1000000007L;

        while (sc.hasNextLong()) {
            long p = sc.nextLong();
            long k = sc.nextLong();

            long l;
            if (k == 0) {
                l = p - 1;
            } else if (k == 1) {
                l = p;
            } else {
                l = -1;
            }

            long ans = 1;

            if (l == -1) {
                long t = 1;
                long v = k;
                while (v != 1) {
                    v = (v * k) % p;
                    t++;
                }
                l = p / t;
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < l; i++) {
                ans = (ans * p) % MOD;
            }

            System.out.println(ans);
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
